rationale: No existing spec exercises the responsive <768px mobile navigation drawer (hamburger toggle, ODrawer, inline ONavGroup submenus). A repo-wide grep for 'mobile', 'hamburger', 'navbar-main-nav' surfaced only the auth-verification rail check (global-setup/enhanced-baseFixtures) and unrelated drawer usage in Alerts/Reports/Correlation specs. The feature is a self-contained new area under GeneralTests, so a dedicated spec (run-context spec_path) is warranted and must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the GeneralTests shard's run_files.
